Script 7 - LDA scores, differencial abundances, and prevalence / relative abundances analyses

Exposure to microplastics alters the expression of immune-related genes and microbiota diversity in mosquito larvae

Ahamed TCHATAKOURA, Marie BUYSSE, Florence Nono Almeida, Marie-Laure SETIER RIO, Olivier ROUX, Claire LOISEAU, Amandine AVILES

0. Loading libraries

library(phyloseq)
library(microbiome)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel) 
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(vegan) 
library(tidyr)
library(metagMisc)
library(pairwiseAdonis)
library(DESeq2) 
library(microbiomeMarker)

library(sjPlot)

0. Load the datasets

metadata <- read.table("metadata.txt", sep="\t", dec = ",", header = TRUE, fill = TRUE, row.names = 1)
metadata$stage <- as.factor(metadata$stage)
metadata$stage <- factor(metadata$stage, levels = c("larvae", "female", "standard"))
metadata$sample_type <- as.factor(metadata$sample_type)
metadata$sample_type <- factor(metadata$sample_type, levels = c("larvae_whole", "female_whole", "female_midgut"))
metadata$treatment <- as.factor(metadata$treatment)
metadata$treatment <- factor(metadata$treatment, levels = c("control", "60", "200", "600"))
metadata$exposition <- as.factor(metadata$exposition)
metadata$exposition <- factor(metadata$exposition, levels = c("unexposed", "exposed"))
metadata$run <- as.factor(metadata$run)
metadata$stage_exp <- as.factor(metadata$stage_exp)
metadata$stage_exp <- factor(metadata$stage_exp, levels = c("UNEXP_larvae", "EXP_larvae", "UNEXP_female", "EXP_female", "UNEXP_femaleMID", "EXP_femaleMID"))

metadata_all <- metadata %>%
  filter(stage %in% c("larvae", "female"))

metadata_L <- metadata %>%
  filter(stage %in% c("larvae"))

metadata_F <- metadata %>%
  filter(stage %in% c("female"))

We create a dataset with only control individuals:

metadata_ctl <- metadata_all %>%
  filter(exposition %in% c("unexposed"))

load("rdata_ALL.RData")
rdata_ctl_1 <- subset_samples(rdata_all, exposition %in% c("unexposed"))
rdata_ctl <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(rdata_ctl_1) > 0, rdata_ctl_1)
rdata_ctl_genus <- tax_glom(rdata_ctl, taxrank=rank_names(rdata_ctl)[6])
rdata_ctl_genus <- phyloseq_rm_na_tax(rdata_ctl_genus)
rdata_ctl_genus_rel <- microbiome::transform(rdata_ctl_genus, "compositional")

We create a dataset with only whole females:

metadata_FW <- metadata_F %>%
  filter(sample_type %in% c("female_whole"))

load("rdata_FEMALE.RData")
rdata_FW_1 <- subset_samples(rdata_F, sample_type %in% c("female_whole"))
rdata_FW <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(rdata_FW_1) > 0, rdata_FW_1)
rdata_FW_genus <- tax_glom(rdata_FW, taxrank=rank_names(rdata_FW)[6])
rdata_FW_genus <- phyloseq_rm_na_tax(rdata_FW_genus)
rdata_FW_genus_rel <- microbiome::transform(rdata_FW_genus, "compositional")

We create a dataset with only midgut females:

metadata_FM <- metadata_F %>%
  filter(sample_type %in% c("female_midgut"))

load("rdata_FEMALE.RData")
rdata_FM_1 <- subset_samples(rdata_F, sample_type %in% c("female_midgut"))
rdata_FM <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(rdata_FM_1) > 0, rdata_FM_1)
rdata_FM_genus <- tax_glom(rdata_FM, taxrank=rank_names(rdata_FM)[6])
rdata_FM_genus <- phyloseq_rm_na_tax(rdata_FM_genus)
rdata_FM_genus_rel <- microbiome::transform(rdata_FM_genus, "compositional")

1. Specific changes in larvae dataset

1.1. LDA scores according to exposure

load("rdata_LARVES_genus.RData")
# set up taxonomy
tax_levels <- c("Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus")
fill_unknowns <- function(tax_row, tax_levels) {
  for(i in seq_along(tax_levels)) {
    level <- tax_levels[i]
    if(tax_row[[level]] == "unknown" | grepl("unknown", tax_row[[level]])) {
      if(i == 1) {
        # Premier niveau
        tax_row[[level]] <- paste0("unknown ", tolower(level))
      } else {
        # Concatène avec le niveau précédent
        prev_val <- tax_row[[tax_levels[i-1]]]
        tax_row[[level]] <- paste0(prev_val, "_unknown ", tolower(level))
      }
    }
  }
  tax_row
}

# Run LEFSE
tax_level <- "Genus"
set.seed(123)
lefse_res <- run_lefse(rdata_L_genus, "exposition", 
  taxa_rank = rank_names(rdata_L_genus)[6],
  lda_cutoff = 2,              # minimum LDA score to consider
  norm = "CPM",                
  kw_cutoff = 0.05             # Kruskal-Wallis p-value cutoff
  )
lda_results <- marker_table(lefse_res)

pvals <- lda_results$pvalue
lda_results$padj_check <- p.adjust(pvals, method = "BH")
lda_filtered <- lda_results[lda_results$padj_check <= 0.05, ]
lda_filtered$padj_star <- ifelse(
  is.na(lda_filtered$padj_check), "NS",
  ifelse(lda_filtered$padj_check < 0.001, "***",
         ifelse(lda_filtered$padj_check < 0.01, "**",
                ifelse(lda_filtered$padj_check < 0.05, "*", "NS")))
)

# Exact order of taxa according to LDA score
lda_df <- data.frame(
  feature = lda_filtered$feature,
  ef_lda = lda_filtered$ef_lda,
  enrich_group = lda_filtered$enrich_group,
  padj_star = lda_filtered$padj_star
)
lda_order <- lda_df %>%
  arrange(ef_lda) %>%
  pull(feature)

# plot LDA scores
p1 <- ggplot(lda_df, aes(x = reorder(feature, ef_lda), y = ef_lda,
                         fill = enrich_group, color = enrich_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = padj_star),
            hjust = ifelse(lda_df$ef_lda > 2, -2, 1),
            size = 4) +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60") +
  labs(x = "Taxa", y = "LDA score",
       title = "LDA scores") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        title = element_text(size=10), 
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "gray20", linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid"),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = 'solid', colour = "gray90"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())


# Set up abundances
meta_df <- as.data.frame(sample_data(rdata_L_genus))
meta_df$SampleID <- rownames(meta_df)
meta_df <- meta_df[, c("SampleID", "exposition")]

otu_mat <- as.matrix(otu_table(rdata_L_genus))
if(!taxa_are_rows(rdata_L_genus)) otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
otu_rel <- sweep(otu_mat, 2, colSums(otu_mat), FUN = "/") * 100

tax_df_full <- as.data.frame(tax_table(rdata_L_genus))
tax_df_full$OTU_ID <- rownames(tax_df_full)

tax_df_full_ok <- tax_df_full %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do(as_tibble(fill_unknowns(as.list(.), tax_levels))) %>%
  ungroup()

tax_df_sig <- tax_df_full_ok %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data[[tax_level]] %in% lda_order)

tax_df_sig <- tax_df_sig %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data[[tax_level]]) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Family = unique(Family),
    Phylum = unique(Phylum),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

otu_mat <- as.matrix(otu_table(rdata_L_genus))
if (!taxa_are_rows(rdata_L_genus)) otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)

otu_rel <- sweep(otu_mat, 2, colSums(otu_mat), FUN = "/") * 100

sig_otus <- tax_df_full_ok$OTU_ID[
  tax_df_full_ok[[tax_level]] %in% tax_df_sig[[tax_level]]
]
otu_rel_sig <- otu_rel[rownames(otu_rel) %in% sig_otus, , drop = FALSE]

df_long <- data.frame(
  SampleID = rep(colnames(otu_rel_sig), each = nrow(otu_rel_sig)),
  OTU_ID = rep(rownames(otu_rel_sig), times = ncol(otu_rel_sig)),
  rel_ab = as.vector(otu_rel_sig)
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(meta_df, by = "SampleID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(tax_df_full_ok[, c("OTU_ID", tax_level)], by = "OTU_ID") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(taxon = .data[[tax_level]], exposition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_ab = mean(rel_ab),
    se_ab = sd(rel_ab)/sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(tax_df_sig, by = c("taxon" = tax_level)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(taxon = factor(taxon, levels = lda_order))

# plot abundances
p2 <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = mean_ab, y = taxon, color = exposition)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = mean_ab - se_ab, xmax = mean_ab + se_ab),
                 height = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  labs(x = "Relative abundances (%)", y = NULL,
       title = "Relative abundances") +
  ylab(NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom", 
        title = element_text(size=10), 
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "gray20", linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid"),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = 'solid', colour = "gray90"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  scale_x_log10()

# plot taxo info
taxon_phylum <- df_long %>%
  distinct(taxon, Family)

p3 <- ggplot(taxon_phylum,
             aes(x = 1, y = taxon, color = Family)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo", name = "Family") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  ) +
  xlim(0.5, 1.5)

# combine
combined_plot <- p1 + p2 + p3 + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 3, widths = c(1, 1, 0.3), guides = "collect") & 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

1.2. log2(fold change) according to exposure

load("rdata_LARVES_genus.RData")
dds <- phyloseq_to_deseq2(rdata_L_genus, ~ exposition)
dds <- DESeq(dds, sfType = "poscounts")
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("exposition", "unexposed", "exposed"))

top_changes <- res[res$padj < 0.05 & !is.na(res$padj), ]
tax_table_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(rdata_L_genus))
top_changes$taxa <- rownames(top_changes)
top_changes$genus <- tax_table_df[top_changes$taxa, "Genus"]
top_changes$genus <- factor(
  top_changes$genus,
  levels = unique(top_changes$genus[order(top_changes$log2FoldChange)])
)

top_changes$padj_star <- ifelse(is.na(top_changes$padj), "NS",
                          ifelse(top_changes$padj < 0.001, "***",
                          ifelse(top_changes$padj < 0.01, "**",
                          ifelse(top_changes$padj < 0.05, "*", "NS"))))

plot <- ggplot(top_changes, aes(x = genus, y = log2FoldChange, color = log2FoldChange > 0)) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = padj_star),
            hjust = ifelse(top_changes$log2FoldChange > 0, -0.1, 1.1),
            size = 4, 
            color = "black") +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60") +
  labs(x = "Taxa", y = "Log2 Fold Change (unexposed vs exposed)",
       title = "Top differentially abundant taxa between unexposed and exposed") +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Direction",
                  values = c("FALSE" = "#2ec7e5", "TRUE" = "#ef4d58"),
                  labels = c("Increased in exposed", "Increased in unexposed")) + 
  theme_bw()

1.4.2. Concentration vs concentration

MP60 vs MP200:

load("rdata_LARVES.RData")
rdata_L_1 <- subset_samples(rdata_L, treatment %in% c("60", "200"))

rdata_L_genus <- phyloseq_rm_na_tax(rdata_L_genus)
rdata_L_genus -> rdata

dds <- DESeq(dds, sfType = "poscounts")

MP60 vs MP600 & MP200 vs MP600 were tested using similar command lines.

Similar command lines were used to analyse the whole females and female midguts’ datasets.

2. Focus on Wolbachia and Elizabethkingia

2.1. How many in unexposed samples?

First, we create a dataframe setting out the metadata and relative abundance for each OTU per unexposed sample:

genera_of_interest <- c(
  "Wolbachia",
  "Elizabethkingia"
)

# extract values
extract_genus_rel_abundance <- function(physeq_rel, genus_name) {
  
  tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(physeq_rel))
  abund <- as.data.frame(otu_table(physeq_rel))
  
  # get OTUs (cluster_x) belonging to that genus
  taxa_interest <- rownames(tax)[tax$Genus == genus_name]
  
  # if genus not found, return an empty dataframe
  if (length(taxa_interest) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No OTU found for genus:", genus_name))
    return(data.frame())
  }
  
  # subset abundance table
  taxa_abund <- abund[taxa_interest, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # sum all OTUs of that genus per sample
  taxa_rel <- colSums(taxa_abund)
  
  # build clean dataframe
  df <- data.frame(
    sample = names(taxa_rel),
    value = taxa_rel,
    row.names = NULL
  )
  
  colnames(df)[2] <- paste0(genus_name)
  
  return(df)
}

list_of_dfs <- lapply(genera_of_interest, function(genus){
  extract_genus_rel_abundance(rdata_ctl_genus_rel, genus)
})

df_rel <- metadata_ctl
df_rel$sample <- rownames(df_rel)
for (df in list_of_dfs) {
  df_rel <- left_join(df_rel, df, by = "sample")
}

# create df for each genus with 0 removed
split_by_genus <- function(df, genera, threshold = 0) {
  lapply(genera, function(genus) {
    
    if (!genus %in% colnames(df)) {
      warning(paste("Genus not found:", genus))
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    df %>%
      filter(.data[[genus]] > threshold)
  }) |> 
    setNames(genera)
}
df_by_genus <- split_by_genus(df_rel, genera_of_interest)

#df_genus_no0 <- df_by_genus$genus

df_rel$SampleID <- rownames(df_rel)
df_rel_graph <- pivot_longer(df_rel, cols = c(
  "Wolbachia",
  "Elizabethkingia"
), names_to = "OTU_type", values_to = "relative_abundance", values_drop_na = FALSE)

From the previous dataframe, we built prevalence and mean relative abundance summaries:

otu_col <- c(
  "Wolbachia",
  "Elizabethkingia"
)
compute_stats_for_otu <- function(df, otu_col, group_var = "sample_type") {
  
  # prevalence
  df_prev <- df %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_var]]) %>%
    summarise(
      n_total = n(),
      n_infected = sum(.data[[otu_col]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      prevalence = n_infected / n_total,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # mean + SE (only positives)
  df_mean <- df %>%
    filter(.data[[otu_col]] > 0) %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_var]]) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_rel_abund = mean(.data[[otu_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      se_rel_abund = sd(.data[[otu_col]], na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # combine
  df_summary <- left_join(df_prev, df_mean, by = group_var)
  
  # add OTU id
  df_summary$OTU <- otu_col
  
  return(df_summary)
}

summary_list <- lapply(otu_col, function(otu){
  compute_stats_for_otu(df_rel, otu)
})

df_all_summaries <- bind_rows(summary_list)

kable(df_all_summaries, caption = "Metrics about Wolbachia and Elizabethkingia in unexposed samples", align = "lllllll")
Metrics about Wolbachia and Elizabethkingia in unexposed samples

Test about prevalence:

# Fisher test Wolbachia
df_Wolb_summaries <-  df_all_summaries %>%
  filter(OTU == "Wolbachia")
# no test because prevalence is 100% vs 100%


# Fisher test Elizabethkingia
df_Eliz_summaries <-  df_all_summaries %>%
  filter(OTU == "Elizabethkingia")
tab <- with(df_Eliz_summaries,
    {
  matrix(
    c(
      n_infected,
      n_total - n_infected
    ),
    nrow = nrow(df_Eliz_summaries),
    byrow = FALSE,
    dimnames = list(
      exposition,
      c("infected", "not_infected")
    )
  )
})
fisher.test(tab)
## 
##  Fisher's Exact Test for Count Data
## 
## data:  tab
## p-value = 0.4545
## alternative hypothesis: true odds ratio is not equal to 1
## 95 percent confidence interval:
##   0.002848937 29.360803313
## sample estimates:
## odds ratio 
##  0.2887006

Test about relative abundance according exposure:

# Wolbachia
df_Wolb <- df_by_genus$Wolbachia
df_Wolb_no0 <- df_Wolb %>%
  filter(Wolbachia > 0)
wilcox.test(Wolbachia ~ exposition, data = df_Wolb_no0)
## 
##  Wilcoxon rank sum exact test
## 
## data:  Wolbachia by exposition
## W = 12, p-value = 0.8636
## alternative hypothesis: true location shift is not equal to 0
# Elizabethkingia
df_Eliz <- df_by_genus$Elizabethkingia
df_Eliz_no0 <- df_Eliz %>%
  filter(Elizabethkingia > 0)
wilcox.test(Elizabethkingia ~ exposition, data = df_Eliz_no0)
## 
##  Wilcoxon rank sum exact test
## 
## data:  Elizabethkingia by exposition
## W = 6, p-value = 0.7111
## alternative hypothesis: true location shift is not equal to 0

Test about relative abundance according concentration (correlation):

# Wolbachia
df_Wolb_no0 <- df_Wolb_no0 %>%
  mutate(treatment = recode(treatment, control = "0"))
df_Wolb_no0$treatment <- as.numeric(as.character(df_Wolb_no0$treatment))
df_Wolb_no0$log_inf <- log10(df_Wolb_no0$Wolbachia)

cor.test(df_Wolb_no0$treatment, df_Wolb_no0$log_inf, method = "spearman")
## 
##  Spearman's rank correlation rho
## 
## data:  df_Wolb_no0$treatment and df_Wolb_no0$log_inf
## S = 205.72, p-value = 0.3768
## alternative hypothesis: true rho is not equal to 0
## sample estimates:
##       rho 
## 0.2806918
# Elizabethkingia
df_Eliz_no0 <- df_Eliz_no0 %>%
  mutate(treatment = recode(treatment, control = "0"))
df_Eliz_no0$treatment <- as.numeric(as.character(df_Eliz_no0$treatment))
df_Eliz_no0$log_inf <- log10(df_Eliz_no0$Elizabethkingia)

cor.test(df_Eliz_no0$treatment, df_Eliz_no0$log_inf, method = "spearman")
## 
##  Spearman's rank correlation rho
## 
## data:  df_Eliz_no0$treatment and df_Eliz_no0$log_inf
## S = 146.43, p-value = 0.7569
## alternative hypothesis: true rho is not equal to 0
## sample estimates:
##      rho 
## 0.112555

# extract values
extract_genus_rel_abundance <- function(physeq_rel, genus_name) {
  
  tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(physeq_rel))
  abund <- as.data.frame(otu_table(physeq_rel))
  
  # get OTUs (cluster_x) belonging to that genus
  taxa_interest <- rownames(tax)[tax$Genus == genus_name]
  
  # if genus not found, return an empty dataframe
  if (length(taxa_interest) == 0) {

    return(data.frame())
  }
  
  # subset abundance table
  taxa_abund <- abund[taxa_interest, , drop = FALSE]

  # build clean dataframe

  "Enterobacter",
  "Delftia",
  "Nevskia",
  "Flavobacterium",

), names_to = "OTU_type", values_to = "relative_abundance", values_drop_na = FALSE)

3.1. Prevalence and relative abundance

From the previous dataframe, we built prevalence and mean relative abundance summaries:

otu_col <- c(
  "Flectobacillus",
  "Sphingorhabdus",
  "Alicycliphilus",
  "Kluyvera",
  "Caenimonas",
  "Erwinia",
  "Pantoea",
  "Serratia",
  "Rahnella1",
  "Pseudacidovorax",
  "Limnohabitans",
  "Comamonas",
  "Enterobacter",
  "Delftia",
  "Nevskia",
  "Flavobacterium",
  "Pseudomonas",
  "Chryseobacterium",
  "Elizabethkingia",
  "Methylophilus"
)
compute_stats_for_otu <- function(df, otu_col, group_var = "exposition") {
  
  # prevalence
  df_prev <- df %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_var]]) %>%
    summarise(
      n_total = n(),
      n_infected = sum(.data[[otu_col]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      prevalence = n_infected / n_total,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # mean + SE (only positives)
  df_mean <- df %>%
    filter(.data[[otu_col]] > 0) %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_var]]) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_rel_abund = mean(.data[[otu_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      se_rel_abund = sd(.data[[otu_col]], na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # combine
  df_summary <- left_join(df_prev, df_mean, by = group_var)
  
  # add OTU id
  df_summary$OTU <- otu_col
  
  return(df_summary)
}

summary_list <- lapply(otu_col, function(otu){
  compute_stats_for_otu(df_rel, otu)
})

df_all_summaries <- bind_rows(summary_list)

Plot:

strip_names <- setNames(genera_of_interest, otu_col)

  geom_col(aes(y = prevalence * 100), alpha = 0.3) +
scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Prevalence (%)",
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)) +
  labs(
    title = "Prevalence",
    x = "Exposition"
  ) +

        title = element_text(size=9),

        strip.text = element_text(size = 7)) + 
  facet_wrap(~ OTU, labeller = labeller(OTU = strip_names))

pB <- ggplot(df_all_summaries, aes(x = exposition,fill = OTU, color = OTU)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_rel_abund * 100), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = (mean_rel_abund - se_rel_abund)*100,

  scale_y_log10(name = "Log10(Mean relative abundance (%))") +

  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", 
        title = element_text(size=9),

pC <- ggplot(df_rel_graph, aes(x= treatment, y = log_rel, fill = OTU_type, color = OTU_type)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 4,)  +

3.3. Focus on Pseudacidovorax and Delftia

3.3.1. In larvae dataset

First, we create a dataframe setting out the metadata and relative abundance for each OTU per sample:

load("rdata_LARVES_genus_rel.RData")
genera_of_interest <- c(
  "Delftia",
  "Pseudacidovorax"
)

# extract values
extract_genus_rel_abundance <- function(physeq_rel, genus_name) {
  
  tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(physeq_rel))
  abund <- as.data.frame(otu_table(physeq_rel))
  
  # get OTUs (cluster_x) belonging to that genus
  taxa_interest <- rownames(tax)[tax$Genus == genus_name]
  
  # if genus not found, return an empty dataframe
  if (length(taxa_interest) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No OTU found for genus:", genus_name))
    return(data.frame())
  }
  
  # subset abundance table
  taxa_abund <- abund[taxa_interest, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # sum all OTUs of that genus per sample
  taxa_rel <- colSums(taxa_abund)
  
  # build clean dataframe
  df <- data.frame(
    sample = names(taxa_rel),
    value = taxa_rel,
    row.names = NULL
  )
  
  colnames(df)[2] <- paste0(genus_name)
  
  return(df)
}

list_of_dfs <- lapply(genera_of_interest, function(genus){
  extract_genus_rel_abundance(rdata_L_genus_rel, genus)
})

df_rel <- metadata_L
df_rel$sample <- rownames(df_rel)
for (df in list_of_dfs) {
  df_rel <- left_join(df_rel, df, by = "sample")
}

# create df for each genus with 0 removed
split_by_genus <- function(df, genera, threshold = 0) {
  lapply(genera, function(genus) {
    
    if (!genus %in% colnames(df)) {
      warning(paste("Genus not found:", genus))
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    df %>%
      filter(.data[[genus]] > threshold)
  }) |> 
    setNames(genera)
}
df_by_genus <- split_by_genus(df_rel, genera_of_interest)

#df_genus_no0 <- df_by_genus$genus

df_rel$SampleID <- rownames(df_rel)
df_rel_graph <- pivot_longer(df_rel, cols = c(
  "Delftia",
  "Pseudacidovorax"
), names_to = "OTU_type", values_to = "relative_abundance", values_drop_na = FALSE)

From the previous dataframe, we built prevalence and mean relative abundance summaries:

    group_by(.data[[group_var]]) %>%
    summarise(
      n_total = n(),
      n_infected = sum(.data[[otu_col]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      prevalence = n_infected / n_total,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # mean + SE (only positives)
  df_mean <- df %>%
    filter(.data[[otu_col]] > 0) %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_var]]) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_rel_abund = mean(.data[[otu_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      se_rel_abund = sd(.data[[otu_col]], na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

summary_list <- lapply(otu_col, function(otu){

Test about relative abundance according exposure:

# Delftia
df_Delf <- df_by_genus$Delftia
df_Delf_no0 <- df_Delf %>%
  filter(Delftia > 0)
wilcox.test(Delftia ~ exposition, data = df_Delf_no0)
## 
##  Wilcoxon rank sum exact test
## 
## data:  Delftia by exposition
## W = 10, p-value = 0.6
## alternative hypothesis: true location shift is not equal to 0
# Pseudacidovorax
df_Pseuda <- df_by_genus$Pseudacidovorax
df_Pseuda_no0 <- df_Pseuda %>%
  filter(Pseudacidovorax > 0)
wilcox.test(Pseudacidovorax ~ exposition, data = df_Pseuda_no0)
## 
##  Wilcoxon rank sum exact test
## 
## data:  Pseudacidovorax by exposition
## W = 18, p-value = 0.1167
## alternative hypothesis: true location shift is not equal to 0

Test about relative abundance according concentration (correlation):

# Delftia
df_Delf_no0 <- df_Delf_no0 %>%
  mutate(treatment = recode(treatment, control = "0"))
df_Delf_no0$treatment <- as.numeric(as.character(df_Delf_no0$treatment))
df_Delf_no0$log_inf <- log10(df_Delf_no0$Delftia)

cor.test(df_Delf_no0$treatment, df_Delf_no0$log_inf, method = "spearman")
## 
##  Spearman's rank correlation rho
## 
## data:  df_Delf_no0$treatment and df_Delf_no0$log_inf
## S = 168.67, p-value = 0.1853
## alternative hypothesis: true rho is not equal to 0
## sample estimates:
##       rho 
## 0.4102418
# Elizabethkingia
df_Pseuda_no0 <- df_Pseuda_no0 %>%
  mutate(treatment = recode(treatment, control = "0"))
df_Pseuda_no0$treatment <- as.numeric(as.character(df_Pseuda_no0$treatment))
df_Pseuda_no0$log_inf <- log10(df_Pseuda_no0$Pseudacidovorax)

cor.test(df_Pseuda_no0$treatment, df_Pseuda_no0$log_inf, method = "spearman")
## 
##  Spearman's rank correlation rho
## 
## data:  df_Pseuda_no0$treatment and df_Pseuda_no0$log_inf
## S = 237.22, p-value = 0.2058
## alternative hypothesis: true rho is not equal to 0
## sample estimates:
##        rho
